title: Motivation Is Overrated; Environment Often Matters More
coreMove: Place the desired cue where attention naturally lands before motivation is needed.
sourcePressure: Behavior often follows what the environment makes visible, nearby, and easy to notice before motivation has to intervene.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning environment design into decluttering advice or claiming motivation never matters.

hook: starting with a definition of environment design
counterintuition: the problem is not motivation alone

exampleSpecs.domain: a dialysis clinic making hand sanitizer the first object every patient sees
exampleSpecs.audience: a clinic manager with uneven hygiene compliance
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether cue placement changes behavior before reminders are spoken
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she moves the sanitizer tower into the doorway path and watches patients reach before signing in
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a sanitizer tower centered in a clinic doorway

exampleSpecs.domain: a saxophonist leaving reeds soaking beside the instrument case
exampleSpecs.audience: a musician who skips warmups when setup feels scattered
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether visible prep pulls practice forward
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the open reed case on the stand makes the first note happen before she debates practicing
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a reed case open on a brass music stand

exampleSpecs.domain: a warehouse picker placing the safety cutter on top of the first bin
exampleSpecs.audience: a supervisor reducing torn packaging and hand injuries
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the right tool becomes what the hand finds first
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the picker reaches for the top bin and closes fingers around the cutter instead of a pocket knife
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a safety cutter clipped to a blue pick bin

exampleSpecs.domain: a botanist moving seed packets from cabinet to germination bench
exampleSpecs.audience: a researcher missing daily germination checks
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether location makes the next observation obvious
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the packets sit under the lamp beside the tray, and the check happens while the timer hums
exampleSpecs.firstImage: seed packets fanned under a grow lamp

exampleSpecs.domain: a hotel night auditor setting the reconciliation folder on the keyboard before shift
exampleSpecs.audience: a night-shift worker prone to skipping the dullest task
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether visible placement beats a 2 a.m. reminder
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the folder blocks the login keys so the reconciliation starts before email opens
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a red reconciliation folder covering a keyboard

exampleSpecs.domain: a family placing helmets on scooter handlebars at the apartment exit
exampleSpecs.audience: a parent tired of yelling down the hallway
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether obvious physical placement changes departure behavior
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the child reaches for the scooter and has to lift the helmet first, proving the cue moved from voice to path
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a scooter handlebar looped through a helmet strap

skillTargets: place cues in natural attention paths

tryThisNowSpec: Move one good-habit cue into your natural line of sight and move one distracting cue out of the first reach path.
